bar.name: v1 HTML fixtures and A2UI for the same apps; 300 blind English requests; independent attack on data safety and meaning

biggest_gap: A rename followed by drop and re-add leaves saved values with no name that can reach them while every verdict says safe (fields and tables), and the evaluator does not move rows on `was`, so 'data is never at risk' has no end-to-end proof.

acceptance.line: >= 90% of 300 blind requests expressible (programs parse and type-check)
acceptance.evidence: round 1 coverage stands: 237 full of 300 (92% of the 257 in-scope); all 300 corpus programs check and run (0 crashes in an interaction sweep); request list not yet stored in the repo beside the corpus
corpus (300 programs by other agents) median 133 planned / 137.5 stock; builder's std-style examples 151; 5.16x fewer than v1 HTML on the planned count, 4.98x on stock

acceptance.line: every prefix cut at a line end parses
acceptance.evidence: critic ran 4,639 prefix checks over 330 programs: 0 failures; 411/411 tests; 20,000-mutation fuzz: 0 crashes

acceptance.line: edits never lose or retype saved data while marked safe
acceptance.evidence: orphaned slot after rename + drop + re-add; eval.mjs keeps rows under the old name after `table drinks was drink`; `mo.mjs diff` with 2 files says safe where the history verdict refuses; option and setting renames under-checked

other_notes: Wrong results: `at <= today` excludes today's rows while `at = today` includes them (cumulative lines one day late); `time - time` is negative across midnight; sum/avg of a time column give 0 silently; since() of empty hides never-done items.

Model-facing: a line starting with a bare name needs `text` and the hint does not say so; comma and argument slips get operator lists as hints; names cannot be constrained by the grammar (96.8% of name swaps pass GBNF but fail the checker), so decoding needs a dynamic name constraint.

Generic holes: no power operator, no nth or random row, no delay action, no row-valued formula parameter; revert after a widening edit is refused by diff; core is confirmed generic (std expands to level 1 only).
